description: This is a Java unit test source file for the class CheckExternalFilter, testing its behavior with different header definitions, including mutability, null handling, filtering logic, and case sensitivity.

classes.name: CheckExternalFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behaviors of CheckExternalFilter methods and ensuring its correctness in various scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that CheckExternalFilter class and its Predicate field are immutable, and its headerDefinitions collection is safely unmodifiable.

methods.name: tryToGetShouldReadFromExternalNullHeaderDefinitions
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to shouldReadFromExternal throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: filterNullValueShouldReadFromExternal
methods.description: Tests that apply returns null when filter value is null and verify no interaction with headerDefinitions.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinitionShouldBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Ensures that when headerDefinitions does not contain the key, the filter returns the original value.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Checks that matching header definition keys result in the value being read and returned.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldNotBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Verifies that header definitions that should not be exposed from external return null.

methods.name: tryToGetShouldWriteToExternalNullHeaderDefinitions
methods.description: Checks that passing null to shouldWriteToExternal throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: filterNullValueShouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Tests that apply returns null for null input and no interactions with headerDefinitions.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinitionShouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Ensures that unmatched keys return the input value.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldBeExposedExternally
methods.description: Validates that header definitions meant to be exposed return the value.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldNotBeExposedExternally
methods.description: Checks that header definitions not meant for external exposure return null.

methods.name: filterShouldNotBeCaseSensitiveForDefinitionKey
methods.description: Tests that header key matching is case-insensitive for various case formats.

methods.name: doFilterShouldNotBeCaseSensitiveForDefinitionKey
methods.description: Helper method that performs case insensitivity tests on header keys.
